Original CSV checksum, verified 2026-11-21:
MD5: 17cca777db64b17170f06f67ce9d3ab7
SHA-256: fa663e3535a7e0763a745993a1f0a192eb0275ac46ad2d1befd7626841e713c1
The bytes were obtained from the unchanged reference copy at
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikaelsundell/colortool/master/resources/CIE_xyz_1931_2deg.csv
and verified against BOTH checksums in the CIE's official metadata.

Runtime interpolation follows the official metadata: linear interpolation,
zero outside 360-830 nm. This does not modify the distributed source table.
XYZ-to-display sRGB uses the matrix and transfer function published by ICC:
https://registry.color.org/rgb-registry/files/sRGB.pdf
Display exposure uses the shared peak of all linear RGB channels; negative/out-of-gamut channels
are clipped. Detector watts and numerical exports are not exposure-scaled.
